title.en: An Act to Amend Section Two thousand One Hundred and Six of the Administrative Code, By Adding Subsection (F) At the End thereof.

text.en:
Section two thousand one hundred and six of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven,
entitled the Administrative Code, is hereby amended by adding, at the end thereof, subsection (f), to read as
"(f) To permit, upon favorable recommendation by the Secretary of Commerce and Communications, and
subject to such conditions as may properly protect the public interests, the construction and maintenance, for
private use, of railways, conduits, and telephone lines across public thoroughfares, streets, roads, and other
public property in the province: Provided, That such construction and private use shall not prevent or obstruct
the public use of such thoroughfares, streets, roads, or other public property, and that the permit granted shall
at all times be subject to revocation by the Secretary of the Interior, if in the judgment of that official, the
public interest requires it."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 24, 1919.
